name: daymark-desktop
description: The official Daymark desktop application for Windows.
author: Michael Fedorovsky

scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:icon && npm run desktop:test && node scripts/pack-windows.mjs
scripts.desktop:verify: npm run verify && npm run desktop:pack && npm run desktop:detach && npm run desktop:scroll
scripts.test:core: tsx --test src/core/store.test.ts src/core/sync.test.ts src/core/smooth-wheel.test.ts src/core/agent-api.test.ts src/core/dates/dates.test.ts
scripts.test:features: tsx --test src/features/calendar/upcoming-model.test.ts src/features/calendar/task-movement.test.ts src/features/capture/capture.test.ts src/features/order/order.test.ts src/features/projects/projects.test.ts src/features/task-editor/task-editor.test.ts src/features/task-editor/form-state.test.ts src/features/reminders/scheduler.test.ts src/features/reorder/long-press.test.ts src/features/tasks/completed-history.test.ts && node --test src/features/companion/companion-context.test.mjs
scripts.test:sites: node --test src/sites-build-contract.test.mjs src/sync-contract.test.mjs src/android-contract.test.mjs src/agent-contract.test.mjs src/agent-api.test.mjs src/database-export-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:features && npm run test:shell && npm run test:sites
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:sites-artifact
